description: This file declares the interface for a SuperImageRebuilder component within the cuttlefish namespace, including a class and function prototypes related to super image rebuilding logic in the Cuttlefish Android virtual device setup.

classes.name: SuperImageRebuilder
classes.description: A class representing a feature related to rebuilding super images, inherits from SetupFeature.

methods.name: SuperImageRebuilderComponent
methods.description: Constructs and returns a component that provides dependencies for SuperImageRebuilder.

methods.name: SuperImageNeedsRebuilding
methods.description: A function that determines whether the super image needs rebuilding based on the fetcher configuration and provided zip files.
